events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and producer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: A legend turns 87
angles.copy: The legendary John Cleese, a true icon of British comedy, is celebrating his 87th birthday today! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but commonly known as the 'White Album', was released in 1968.

angles.name: White Album anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles unleashed their iconic self-titled double album, forever known as the 'White Album'. Which track is your absolute favourite?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Freddie Mercury, the flamboyant lead singer of Queen, who would have been 80 years old.

angles.name: Tribute to Freddie Mercury
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who left us 35 years ago today. His voice, stage presence, and legacy continue to inspire. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul anniversary
angles.copy: It's 61 years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'! Widely considered a pivotal album in their evolution. What's your top track from this classic?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of John Lennon, who would have been 86 years old.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: 46 years ago, the world lost a musical visionary. Today, we remember John Lennon and his incredible impact on music and culture. What's the song that means the most to you?

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Today would have been the 80th birthday of the iconic British musician and artist David Bowie, who passed away in 2016.

angles.name: Bowie 80th tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the legend, David Bowie, who would have turned 80 today. His artistry continues to inspire generations. What's your all-time favourite Bowie track?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Today would have been the 92nd birthday of the 'King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley, who passed away in 1977.

angles.name: Elvis 92nd birthday tribute
angles.copy: Happy heavenly birthday to the one and only King, Elvis Presley, who would have been 92 today. His music lives on! What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: English guitarist, songwriter, and producer Jimmy Page, best known as the founder of Led Zeppelin, celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Rock legend Jimmy Page at 83
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist, Jimmy Page! His riffs shaped rock history. What's your favourite Zeppelin track?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Sir Rod Stewart, the iconic British singer-songwriter known for his distinctive raspy voice, celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Rod Stewart at 82
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the legendary Sir Rod Stewart! From rock anthems to timeless ballads, his voice is unmistakable. What's your favourite Rod hit?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)' and 'Every Time You Go Away', celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Paul Young's 71st
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the blue-eyed soul legend, Paul Young! Those iconic 80s hits still sound incredible. What's your top Paul Young tune?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary American singer-songwriter, actress, and businesswoman Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday.

angles.name: Dolly Parton's 81st
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true icon whose music and spirit shine brighter than a rhinestone. What's your favourite Dolly song?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: English singer, songwriter, and Take That frontman Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Gary Barlow at 56
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! From pop anthems to solo hits, he's given us so much. What's your favourite Gary-penned song?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer-songwriter Billy Ocean, known for his string of R&B and pop hits in the 70s and 80s, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Billy Ocean's 77th
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the incredible Billy Ocean! Get outta our dreams and into our cars with some classic hits today. What's your favourite track from him?

events.title: First Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction
events.blurb: The first-ever induction ceremony for the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame was held in 1989, honouring pioneers like Elvis Presley, Chuck Berry, and The Beatles.

angles.name: Hall of Fame debut
angles.copy: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its inaugural induction ceremony. A huge moment for music history! Who do you think should be inducted next?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Mark Owen, best known as a member of Take That, celebrates his 55th birthday.

angles.name: Mark Owen at 55
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! Still bringing the pop magic. What's your favourite Mark Owen moment, solo or with the band?

events.title: The Beatles' rooftop concert anniversary
events.blurb: In 1969, The Beatles performed their famous impromptu rooftop concert on top of the Apple Corps building in London, their final public performance.

angles.name: Beatles rooftop gig
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles made history with their iconic rooftop concert! Imagine being there for their final public performance. What's your favourite track from that legendary set?

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: English drummer, singer, songwriter, and record producer Phil Collins, known for his solo career and work with Genesis, celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: Phil Collins at 76
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! A drumming maestro and hitmaker for decades. What's your favourite Phil Collins or Genesis track?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: American singer, songwriter, actor, and record producer Justin Timberlake, who rose to fame with NSYNC before a successful solo career, celebrates his 46th birthday.

angles.name: JT's 46th birthday
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From boyband heartthrob to solo superstar. What's your favourite JT song?

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Sir David Jason, the beloved English actor known for iconic roles as Del Boy in Only Fools and Horses and Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Sir David Jason at 87
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! From Peckham to Poplar, his characters are etched in our hearts. What's your favourite David Jason role?

events.title: Anniversary of 'The Day The Music Died'
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died' in 1959, when rock and roll stars Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash.

angles.name: Remembering 'The Day The Music Died'
angles.copy: 68 years ago today, we lost three legends in 'The Day The Music Died'. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper. Their music lives on.
